intro.text: A Rosharan creature known to fight over its prey.
A flying Rosharan creature, often seen with small arrow-headed luckspren darting around it in flight. Skyeels will squabble over prey.

description.text: Sebarial's banner has its glyphs drawn in the shape of a skyeel.
Skyeels nest and guard their young closely, and have a name for being vicious and repellent.
Sailors call a ship's crow's nest the eel's nest.
Even so, the Wandersail's crew keep a female skyeel aboard as a rat-catching pet, and most of them like her.
